_comment: textDocument/definition is spec'd as `Definition | DefinitionLink[] | null`, where `Definition = Location | Location[]` and `DefinitionLink = LocationLink`. That is four accepting shapes plus null, and a real server emits exactly one of them — clangd returns Location, gopls LocationLink[], pyright Location[]. Only a scripted server can cover the rest. Each scenario in this family answers a *different* method with a different variant so one spawn exercises them all: the client must resolve every one to the same target.
